title: Boowomp
blurb: Two notes descending, and the enthusiasm is gone. The boowomp is SpongeBob's small-failure sting, and no sad sound has ever been more useful: nothing has been destroyed, nobody is hurt, there is just a quiet oh where the excitement used to be. Meme culture took it for anticlimaxes, politely worded rejections and the exact moment optimism meets logistics. Curiously, it gets funnier the smaller the disappointment. A failed heist deserves an orchestra; a vending machine eating your coin deserves this and nothing more.
origin: The classic deflated sting from SpongeBob SquarePants, adopted for gentle failures.
